content.reasoning: There are no comparable sales on the platform yet, so this band comes from your 50 to 85 percent policy and general clearance rules, not real demand data. Grade A current-season lawn three-piece with a fairly balanced size spread argues for the gentler end, but stitched seasonal fashion, 45 days already listed, and a large lot with fewer buyers able to take it all argue for more off, so your current 70 percent sits sensibly inside this band. Please check your counts: the size spread adds up to 500 pieces, not the 5000 listed, and the price and buyer pool change a lot depending on which is right. If it really is 5000 pieces, splitting it into smaller lots would likely move it faster than going deeper on discount, and summer stock will need more off the closer it gets to autumn.
